data.description:
Make every llama-proxy restart attributable from the logs alone. Analysis of 170 restarts (2026-10-09..10-16, LP-0MV9UNKVK007TN7E) found 3 restarts with NO trigger signature within 90s of the 'Starting LLama Proxy Server' marker, and all 167 mode-switch restarts are indistinguishable: the /admin/set-mode handler and start-proxy.sh --restart do not log who/why requested the switch. Sources: web UI/API and the ContextHub mode-switch-worker POST /admin/set-mode with no actor attribution; start-proxy.sh --restart can be invoked manually with no reason recorded.

ACs:
- [ ] Every 'Mode-switch restart spawned' line is preceded by an actor/reason (source=scheduler|worker|api|manual, actor, requested mode) captured at set_mode() time
- [ ] start-proxy.sh --restart writes an optional reason visible in the new process startup log, so operator restarts are attributable
- [ ] A reproducible grep attributes every restart in the retained logs (zero unattributable) -- demonstrated on the new logging path

References: discovered-from:LP-0MV9UNKVK007TN7E. Related: LP-0MV9UNE75004903J, LP-0MV9UNGEB009XUZ5.
data.title: Log the requesting actor and reason for every proxy mode-switch / --restart so restarts are always attributable
